name: learning-still-wet-twice
description: 'Still wet' learning: a let_top_dry Monstera (I=7) watered 2026-11-02 is reported still wet on 11-09 and 11-10. Window as of 11-11.
why: PROVISIONAL. Each still_wet snoozes by max(1, round(25% of I)) = 2 days and adds the same to the learned adjustment, capped at ceil(I/2) = 4. Two logs give adjustment 4, effective interval 11, band [8,14], anchor 11, and the window may not open before the day after the last log. The earlier draft printed [8,10] for the superseded one-day model.
